## Proof

Let $X$ be the set of $p$-tuples $(g_1, \ldots, g_p)$ with $g_1 \cdots g_p = e$. Then $|X| = |G|^{p-1}$, and $\Z/p$ acts on $X$ by rotation. The fixed points are the tuples $(g, \ldots, g)$ with $g^p = e$. Count modulo $p$: the number of fixed points is divisible by $p$, and $(e, \ldots, e)$ is one of them.

## Idea

Count the tuples in two ways.
